groups.name: data
groups.description: Persistent data inventory, recovery points, restore and verification

commands.name: inventory
commands.description: List heuristic mutable directories under a scenario and their binding coverage.

flags.name: bindings
flags.description: JSON array of declared data bindings [{"id","path"}]. Accepts raw JSON or b64:<base64url JSON> for argv-only transports.

commands.name: backup
commands.description: Capture a consistent, encrypted, checksummed recovery point of the declared data bindings through their providers (pg_dump custom format for PostgreSQL, inventory archive for object stores). Fenced and receipted per (operation, step).

flags.name: binding
flags.description: JSON binding {id, kind, provider, locator, migration_owner?, quiesce?, release?} or a JSON array; repeat for several. Accepts raw JSON or b64:<base64url JSON> for argv-only transports.

flags.name: key-ref
flags.description: Recovery key reference (logical_id:field) resolved through the credential authority; key material never appears in argv or receipts.

flags.name: recovery-point-dir
flags.description: Absolute directory for the recovery point. Defaults to the deployment's recovery-points directory.

flags.name: schema-version
flags.description: Persistent-data schema version the recovery point binds to.

flags.name: configuration-digest
flags.description: Configuration digest the recovery point binds to.

flags.name: credential-version-ref
flags.description: Credential version reference (never a value); repeat for several.

flags.name: provider
flags.description: Backup provider owner recorded on the manifest (e.g. data-backup-manager).

flags.name: provider-ref
flags.description: Provider-side reference of the registered target.

flags.name: retention-policy
flags.description: Retention policy name recorded on the manifest.

flags.name: migration-posture
flags.description: Storage migration posture selected for this capture.

commands.name: restore
commands.description: Restore a recovery point into clean bindings on this target. Refuses recovery_point_corrupt, recovery_key_unavailable and restore_target_not_clean before any write; never overwrites operator-owned data. Fenced and receipted.

flags.name: recovery-point-dir
flags.description: Absolute directory of the recovery point (defaults to the deployment's recovery-points directory).

flags.name: into
flags.description: Restore target as <binding>=<locator> or a JSON object; repeat for several.

flags.name: binding
flags.description: Restrict the restore to this binding id; repeat for several.

commands.name: verify
commands.description: Verify a recovery point without restoring it: manifest digest, sealed artifact checksums, optional key resolution and decryption, and expected inventory invariants.

flags.name: recovery-point-dir
flags.description: Absolute directory of the recovery point (defaults to the deployment's recovery-points directory).

flags.name: open
flags.description: Also resolve the recovery key and decrypt every artifact.

flags.name: expect
flags.description: JSON {binding: {count, checksum}} of the expected inventory (e.g. fixture-oracle/v1).
